purpose: Help a chess tutor inspect the original manually requested Queen draft by separating limited rule checks, legal move observations and unassessed prose. Never certify the whole explanation.

current_experiment_state.original_manual_Queen_runtime: Remains the existing qualified NF4 no-cache runtime; no source, settings, prompt, default or eligibility change proposed.
current_experiment_state.new_cold_software_qualification: Fourth attempt passed its independent closed audit for two EOS requests. Its unknown-image live-to-EXIT observations do not identify NVIDIA or establish 96-request stability/quality.
current_experiment_state.fresh_fixed256_vs64_comparison: All 96 calls UNRUN after the 11:30 UTC admission deadline. No worker, raw panel or score; 16-root reservation retained and unspent by model calls.
current_experiment_state.new_countertraining192: UNRUN after its strict 11:00 UTC deadline.
current_experiment_state.trained64_UI: Unavailable; this proposal cannot admit or promote it.
current_experiment_state.time_authority: No extension beyond the existing 13:00 UTC cutoff.

source_inspection.platform: Existing localhost Python HTTP service and plain JavaScript/CSS web interface, used with desktop keyboard/pointer and compact mobile widths.
current_strengths: A draft retains original position and selected-move context; stale drafts are identified and excluded from current-position export.
The full raw receipt and actual runtime attribution are retained. Main prose is shortened with a native disclosure, not rewritten.
Stockfish search evidence and deterministic board facts already occupy a separate panel.
source_inspection.concrete_gap: Legal raw-move/critical-line labels currently sit beside completely unverified prose, with no statement-level check or explicit coverage record. A tutor must manually connect every claim to its board.
source_inspection.limits: Source-only review. No live page, HTTP, server, engine, model, GPU or held-reference call was made. Palette contrast below is calculated from existing CSS values, not inferred from screenshots.

proposed_user_flow: The user requests a Queen explanation through the existing action. The board stays usable and existing cancellation/busy handling stays intact.
Only after the owned generation worker has ended, the service computes bounded CPU-only checks from the exact retained raw response and original saved request. No new model or engine call occurs.
A small Rule checks for this draft section appears below the existing draft preview, before advanced raw execution details. Existing unverified-draft labeling remains.
The section states its requested-position context and shows legal raw-move observations separately from any matched statements. It always states that other text is unassessed.
Recognized statement rows use Supported, Contradicted or Unassessed text. An Inspect matched statements disclosure shows exact raw excerpts, rule observations and explicit branch context.
Existing stale/return/export behavior applies to the checks and draft together. Navigation or a different selected move never rebinds checks to the new board; returning restores the original context.

scope_and_mapping.phase1_branch: Requested root position only: branch_uci=[] and root side to move. No automatic interpretation of later critical-line plies, conditionals, quoted variations, strategic claims or pronouns across arbitrary prose.
scope_and_mapping.raw_authority: Exact original response bytes and response.raw_text; never derive claim spans from translated decoded_text, the current visual board, an engine PV, or a replacement FEN.
scope_and_mapping.strict_root_move: Reuse the frozen native parser for BEST_MOVE and atom identity. Require one unambiguous field, a legal root move, correct mover/victim/promotion descriptors, and no accepted fallback. Duplicate/malformed fields abstain.
scope_and_mapping.board_observations: For a strictly accepted legal raw BEST_MOVE, independently replay that one move and report immediate check/checkmate and capture/victim facts. These are labeled rule-derived observations, not supported prose claims or why the move is best.
scope_and_mapping.automatic_claim_grammar: Assess check/mate and capture prose only when there is exactly one ANALYSIS section whose entire non-whitespace body is the canonical two-sentence block: The move <one native move atom> gives checkmate|gives check|does not give check. It captures <one native piece atom>. OR It does not capture a piece. No leading/trailing prose, conditional text, quotes, duplicate section, second move sentence, or unparsed native-token gaps are allowed.
scope_and_mapping.why_full_block: The existing strict scorer finds narrow grammar anywhere in ANALYSIS; that alone cannot establish that an earlier conditional branch was absent. The UI version therefore adds a full-block/root-context guard rather than inheriting the scorer as a general prose verifier.
scope_and_mapping.grammar_replay: Parse the described move from the original root, require exact legal atom identity, record its UCI/SAN, then compare only the check/mate phrase and immediately adjacent capture phrase against that replay. The ANALYSIS move is not silently replaced by BEST_MOVE or selected_uci.
scope_and_mapping.selected_move_identity: When a legal selected_uci was actually supplied, compare it with the strictly accepted raw BEST_MOVE and bind the structured BEST_MOVE span. Match is Supported and a different legal move is Contradicted for this identity check only. Illegal/ambiguous BEST_MOVE is Unassessed. Free-position mode has no supplied-move claim and displays No selected move was supplied.
scope_and_mapping.independence_of_checks: Any recognized ANALYSIS-move alignment with selected_uci is recorded separately from BEST_MOVE identity. A different ANALYSIS move is never used as an unannounced context repair.
scope_and_mapping.unassessed: Unsupported free prose and ambiguous/illegal contexts remain explicitly unassessed, including every claim after an unmapped variation. An invalid preceding branch never becomes an invented board that forces a later false verdict.
scope_and_mapping.expected_coverage_limit: Original baseline Queen prose often will not match this fixed grammar. Zero matched statements must remain a normal honest outcome. The useful default is then raw-move board observations plus explicit unassessed prose, not a quality badge.

reuse_and_frozen_boundaries.reuse_native_functions: The reviewed scripts/chess_queen_adapter.py has no model-loading imports at module scope. Reuse only its finite FIELDS/MOVE/PIECES/input_packet/parse_atom/parse_output pure parsing functions through an explicit pinned module load. CPU tests will forbid Torch/transformers/bitsandbytes initialization. Do not call NativeQueen.
reuse_and_frozen_boundaries.offline_claim_auditor: The 38-test offline auditor correctly binds exact response bytes, spans and explicit legal branches, but requires separately reviewed manual semantic mappings and a frozen four-response pool. Do not call its CLI, reuse those annotations, or portray it as automatic NLP. Reuse its hash/span/context discipline as a design contract; its original source/protocol/measurement stay unchanged.
reuse_and_frozen_boundaries.strict_counterfactual_scorer: Read as the grammar/association reference only. Do not import its score/panel/trainer or open its labels/references. The new UI guard is separately versioned, not a change to any held metric.
reuse_and_frozen_boundaries.dependency_check: The existing original UI runtime qualification binds the native/NF4 adapter, worker and numerical protocols. Their listed kernel/parity dependency paths do not include the proposed UI/controller files. All qualified files, source manifests, data, generation settings, launcher and tuned-profile admission remain untouched.
reuse_and_frozen_boundaries.before_any_implementation: Recheck the listed current source hashes and coordinate any owner changes; do not patch around a source race.

backend_contract.new_record_location: A sibling verification field on the coaching job returned by existing GET /api/coach/<request_id>. No new HTTP endpoint and no client-supplied annotations, executable paths, branch FENs or verifier settings.

record_schema.status: checked | unassessed | unavailable; software processing state, never whole-draft quality
record_schema.bindings: Exact response_sha256, raw_text_sha256, original saved input_sha256, verifier source/dependency hashes and original request_id.
record_schema.context: response.input.fen, original selected_uci, expected root turn, branch_uci=[], and a requested-position label; no live-board lookup.
record_schema.move_observations: Strictly parsed raw move, legal replay evidence, check/checkmate, capture/victim. Separate from claim statuses.
record_schema.selected_identity: Supplied versus strictly accepted reported move, its own raw BEST_MOVE span, status/reason.
record_schema.claims: Per matched statement: kind, exact raw code-point [start,end) span plus substring SHA-256, expected assertion, observed value, supported/contradicted/unassessed, explicit root branch and bounded reason.
record_schema.unassessed_regions: Raw ANALYSIS intervals outside accepted canonical mapping, with reasons. No inferred sentence count or total-prose-coverage percentage.
record_schema.limitations: whole_prose_assessed=false; semantic scope is fixed grammar/root mapping; no explanation quality/strategic correctness/engine-bestness/human validation.

backend_contract.input_binding: At job creation retain the actual saved request byte hash and immutable packet/context after existing validation, without changing its bytes or fields. The checker must require those original bindings, raw.input equality and the existing canonical runtime provenance check.
backend_contract.raw_binding: Read a bounded raw response byte snapshot only after worker closure, validate duplicate/nonfinite JSON and exact raw_text shape, and ensure it corresponds to the base result before any UI decoration. Preserve that byte snapshot hash; do not mutate result.raw_text, decoded_text, parsed fields or the original response file.
backend_contract.completion_policy: Phase 1 checks only completed EOS original-runtime results with valid UI provenance. Partial, failed, cancelled, fixture-only or provenance-invalid results retain raw visibility but get an explicit unassessed/unavailable reason. A later broader policy would need separate review.
backend_contract.bounds: Existing 1 MiB response bound; at most 100,000 raw characters; one canonical root move and at most two prose claims plus selected-identity metadata. No branch search, history guessing, recursive parsing, network or engine calls. Prior-history validation remains bounded by the frozen parser.
backend_contract.failure_policy: Any verifier parse/binding/CPU failure produces unavailable/unassessed checks, never Supported and never model-output repair or automatic regeneration. The original draft/result and board remain usable.
backend_contract.retention: Save a separate create-only draft-checks-v1.json in the owned request folder when possible, with a clear retention failure if writing fails. Do not overwrite raw response, input, worker, experimental source or evidence.
backend_contract.export: Existing app.js exports the current matching coaching job; adding a job sibling includes checks without changing raw data or exporter behavior. Stale jobs and checks continue to be excluded together.

main_copy.heading: Rule checks for this draft
main_copy.scope: Only the statements listed here were checked. Other text is unassessed.
main_copy.zero_match: No draft statements match the limited checker. Other text is unassessed.
main_copy.stale: These checks belong to the earlier requested position.
main_copy.binding_failure: Rule checks are unavailable for this draft. The original response is still available.

presentation.compact_wireframe: Same single-column order at 390px, with wrapped labels and full-width disclosure target. No extra toolbar, modal, floating badge or second analysis dashboard.
presentation.type: Reuse system UI font. New heading .875rem/600, body .875rem/1.6 and status labels .8125rem/600; no miniature all-caps evidence captions or new typeface.
presentation.palette: Reuse existing surface/text/muted/accent/error tokens, with supported/contradicted/unassessed text labels. No large green success surface and no global pass icon.
presentation.accessibility: Native details/summary; visible existing focus styles; at least 44px summary target; no color-only statuses; DOM textContent for all model strings; long native excerpts wrap; screen-reader order follows content. Preserve focus/disclosure state across polling instead of rebuilding it on every render. Announce completion once in a small polite status, not the full draft repeatedly.
presentation.span_rendering: Backend indices are Python Unicode code points. Frontend uses Array.from(raw_text) for slices, never UTF-16 offset assumptions. Show exact raw excerpt in details. Human-readable UCI/SAN and predicate labels are separate display metadata, not a replacement quote or a claimed one-to-one decoded_text span.
presentation.motion: No new animation, gesture, spring, auto-scroll or automatic board movement. Existing reduced-motion behavior remains. User chooses disclosures and return-to-position.

design_basis.applied: Purpose, agency, restraint and web-native behavior; proportional small-panel change.

design_basis.quote: Use progressive disclosure to make layouts cleaner and easier to interact with.
design_basis.applied: One small section and a native disclosure, retaining board/draft hierarchy.

design_basis.quote: Convey information with more than color alone.
design_basis.applied: Literal status words and visible keyboard focus.

design_basis.quote: In general, avoid light font weights.
design_basis.applied: Existing system type and readable regular/semibold labels.

design_basis.quote: Set clear expectations about what your AI-powered feature can and can’t do.
design_basis.applied: Keep unassessed coverage and limited rule scope visible.
Short labels name the action/status without suggesting whole-prose verification.
Translate typography/resize/disclosure/accessibility principles to web HTML/CSS, rather than native Apple chrome.
Plain precise language, no generic claims or inflated verification language.

minimal_existing_edits: prototype/chess_tutor_v1/coaching_jobs.py (input hash retention, post-generation checker, sibling public record)
proposed_file_ownership_if_authorized.documentation: A short separately versioned verifier scope note only if root assigns a new documentation path. Parent retains repository-wide docs/Git/runtime ownership.

verification_before_activation.source_review: Exact complete source/tests/test receipts in finite bundles below30KB, split by pure checker/controller/frontend. Parent and independent reviewer inspect before deployment.
meaningful_CPU_cases: Exact input/response/span hashes and same-path tampering; changed selected move on the same board; stale context/return/export.
White and Black native POV, quiet/check/mate, capture/victim, en passant, promotion, castling, game over, and checking move that ends an automatic draw without a forced-reply claim.
Duplicate/malformed ANALYSIS/BEST fields; illegal mover/victim/promotion atom; quote, conditional prefix, two move sentences, extra trailing prose and unassociated capture all abstain.
ANALYSIS describes a different legal move from BEST or supplied selected move: keep identity/alignment distinct and never substitute boards.
Unicode before a span, exact code-point slice/hash, translated_text differing length, XSS-like text rendered inert, and response payload-size bounds.
Checker failure/retention failure leaves raw and board available, never retries generation; Torch/transformers/bitsandbytes/model/engine entrypoints blocked during CPU checks.
verification_before_activation.browser_QA_later_root_owned: Use a clearly labeled CPU interface fixture for 390px and desktop/200% zoom, keyboard disclosure/focus, stale navigation/selected alternative/return/export, and empty/unassessed/error states. No actual runtime call in this design lane.
verification_before_activation.actual_manual_Queen_smoke: Only if root decides the UI wiring still needs it after CPU/browser checks, at most one fresh authored request through the original qualified manual runtime under the root-owned GPU lease. Freeze source/input/intent/output first. No fresh held comparison, trained64 admission or model-quality claim.
verification_before_activation.success_definition: A tutor can identify what statement and requested board a rule result refers to, recover exact raw text/export, and see the unassessed remainder. Success is software inspectability, not stronger chess understanding.

non_goals: No general NLP claim extraction or manual semantic gold labels.
No material advantage, tactics, pin/defense/recapture, strategy, positional or teaching-quality verdict.
No automatic post-processing repair, suppressing false text, rewriting claims, engine-selected replacement or additional generator inputs.
No training/prompt change, evaluation redefinition, held-reference read, model reselection, scheduler or deadline extension.
decision_requested_from_parent: Approve or narrow this ownership/scope before implementation. No production files were changed for this proposal.
